_how: Maintenance switch for every version of Blipville. Set one to true to close it: players see the message below until it's false again. classic = Blipville.exe, recode = Blipville-Recode.exe, web = the website version (go/). Apps check about every 5 minutes (every minute while closed); the website every 2 minutes. Updates still work while closed. link and link_text add a button (leave link empty for none). Easiest way: Actions -> Maintenance mode -> Run workflow.
message: We're fixing some bugs and rebuilding the desktop app from the ground up as Blipville Recode. Hang tight, it's almost ready!
